caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a seated male figure, dressed in a dark blue jacket, yellow vest, white shirt, gray bow tie, and brown pants, with black hair, and his hands positioned near his chest, sitting in a reddish-brown ornate chair with light beige side panels decorated with floral and circular patterns. The main image is at the top center, rendered in full color. Below it, there are three smaller, less detailed views of the same figure and chair: a left-side profile (showing the label “BANK” on the chair panel), a front view, and a rear view (showing “PAT. DEC. 23, 18--” inscribed on the back of the chair), each in lighter hues, and signed “HARRY GROSSEN” under the left profile. The background is plain, uncolored paper.
title: Tammany Bank
